item.title: Worldview Weekly — August 27, 2026
item.description: Worldview Weekly. August twenty-seventh, twenty twenty-six. This week’s edition is about systems under pressure. Not the drama of the latest headline, but the slower changes underneath it: China’s accumulation of industrial and scientific capacity; Europe learning to live with extreme heat; African governments trying to capture more value from the green transition; Peru’s uneasy combination of monetary stability and political breakdown; the fading of the neoliberal settlement and of international legal constraint; the stubborn economics of industrial decarbonization; the problem of democratic control over artificial intelligence; and the changing meaning of nuclear deterrence.
